Shaughnessy Laneway House for Rent

4386 Alexandra Street, Vancouver

Welcome to this newly built laneway house located in the prestigious Shaughnessy neighborhood. This home offers an ideal living environment for families or professionals seeking comfort and convenience to schools.

Property Highlights

Private laneway house with separate entrance

Bright and functional layout

Peaceful residential setting

School Proximity

This home is steps away from some of Vancouver’s top private schools, making it an excellent choice for families:

York House School – walking distance

Little Flower Academy – walking distance

Close commute to St. George’s School, Crofton House School,  St. Johns and other top independent schools

 Prime Location

Easy access to Downtown Vancouver, Kerrisdale, and UBC

Close to transit, parks, and daily amenities

Quiet yet highly connected neighborhood


Requirements:
 * Complete Credit Check
 * References Required 
* One Year Lease minimum
 * Damage Deposit is 1/2 Months' Rent. 
* No smoking, No pets.


Lease Terms
1 year
